description: Ordered list of facts needing visual assets for the Useless Knowledge App.

items.imageAlt: Image priority: show a simple map with true north, magnetic north, and the declination angle labeled.
items.notes: SVG generated after Wikimedia Commons search returned no clearly relevant diagram.

items.imageAlt: Image priority: overhead beach diagram showing a narrow rip current pulling outward and arrows pointing parallel to shore.
items.notes: Downloaded public-domain Wikimedia Commons rip current diagram via thumbnail endpoint after full-resolution redirect returned HTTP 429.

items.imageAlt: Image priority: person standing at midday with a short shadow and a small UV index scale nearby.
items.notes: SVG fallback generated after Wikimedia Commons API searches failed locally with SSL errors.

items.imageAlt: Image priority: compass rose with an arrow labeled west wind moving from west to east.
items.notes: SVG fallback generated after three Wikimedia Commons API searches failed locally with SSL connection errors.

items.imageAlt: Image priority: Pacific map with the International Date Line bending around island groups.
items.notes: Downloaded Wikimedia Commons International Date Line map after license verification; Node fetch used because PowerShell and curl hit local TLS credential errors.
